purpose: Run Geant4 correctly for research: a pinned, recorded build from source (geant4_build.py), the official examples B1, B4a, TestEm3 and TestEm5 compared with their reference outputs by the statistical meaning of each printed quantity (geant4_examples.py), a layered-slab simulation program driven by a JSON spec with per-event CSV output (layered_sim, geant4_run.py with scan, partition chunks, reduce and an oracle that calls hep-detector's geant4_benchmarks.py), and four implementation checks (geant4_verify.py: overlaps, material budget, energy balance, mirror). From 0.2.0 (Geant4 program A2) the shared headers g4sim/ (seed hash, per-event seeding, run summary accumulators, the effective-config probe, materials, physics lists, CSV helpers) and three boundary artifacts per run: the run summary (simulation-summary/1, summary.json, merged across threads), the column map (simulation-columns/1, column_map.json) and the effective config (stored once per content hash, with the tree-v1 geometry hashes); summary_from_csv.py stays as the summary's test oracle. Every record is unvalidated: a run that completes is verification at most; hep-detector decides physics. Optional, required by no skill. From 0.3.0 (Geant4 program B1) a second program, element_sim: box elements with one level of nesting, uniform field regions built with an explicit DormandPrince745 stepper and interpolation driver, plane crossings of every charged track, calorimeter leakage by face, per-event seeding only, the same three boundary artifacts and a per-event ROOT file (element_sim.events/1, written with Geant4's bundled g4tools, never committed) read by simroot (info, dump, hash); geant4_run.py check-spec (schema and cross-field rules, element_spec.py) and from-geometry (design-geometry/1 plus an element_sim.realization/1 profile to an element_sim.spec/1, deterministic); geant4_verify.py field, the deterministic field check against the analytic helix of core/simulation/helix.py. From 0.4.0 (Geant4 program B2) simreco, a C++17 digitization and reconstruction program that needs no Geant4 (built with -ffp-contract=off): Gaussian point errors or a strip digitization, a Gauss-Newton fit of chained circle arcs with the multiple-scattering covariance in both projections, TOF beta and calorimeter energy, four switchable tail sources (alignment and calibration-non-uniformity as reconstruction replicas, noise-digitization, pattern-recognition) and a run summary (simulation-summary/1); geant4_run.py reco (simroot dump, simreco per replica, a computational-run with extension.reconstruction) and table (a simulated dataset-record and the f4-results/1 file check_geant4_study.py label --results reads); from-geometry also realizes geometry mapping 1.1.0's optional fields (tracker material and size, field extent, TOF layers, calorimeter front face, depth and sampling). 0.4.1 (Geant4 program B3, J15): element_sim field.max_track_time_ns kills loopers in vacuum field regions; simreco draws a random strip-grid phase per plane and event, gives digitized hits the sharing-aware resolution sqrt((p - w)^3 / 12 p) and refuses a digitization finer than the declared point resolution, computes shower containment from the calorimeter deposits, caps a counting interval at zero, and has a test-only TOF layer offset (the TOF benchmarks' negative control)

tools.name: Geant4 build and official examples (geant4_build.py, geant4_examples.py): Geant4 11.4.3 from https://github.com/Geant4/geant4 (tag v11.4.3), Geant4 Software License 1.0
tested_versions: Geant4 11.4.3 (commit 2ee379e6843e55b9c6bbb835d2a2b03cc998fef0) built twice on E2 on 2026-10-21 with Apple clang 21.0.0 and CMake 4.3.2 (C++17, MT, internal CLHEP, no visualization), eleven datasets (no G4NDL) MD5-verified and content-hashed; the clean rebuild gave the same version, dataset hashes and example values; B1, TestEm3 run 0 and TestEm5 runs 0-4 agree with the reference outputs (48 quantities, Bonferroni |z| <= 3.28) and the B4a smoke comparison passes (VALIDATION GEANT4-ADAPTER)

tools.name: layered_sim, element_sim, simroot, simreco, the g4sim headers, geant4_run.py, geant4_verify.py, element_spec.py, simreco_spec.py and summary_from_csv.py (this plugin's code; the programs link against the user's Geant4 installation)
tested_versions: layered_sim built against Geant4 11.4.3 on E2 (2026-10-21): mirror runs of TestEm3 run 0 (10000 events) and TestEm5 run 0 (1e5 events) agree with the local examples; overlap, material-budget and energy-balance checks pass and their five negative tests are caught; a cut scan under run_workflow.py and a four-chunk local_partition.py run agree with a single run; the runs are of invented layouts (synthetic geometries), so the status stays demonstrated-on-synthetic-data

adapter 0.2.0 built against Geant4 11.4.3 on E2 (2026-10-24): the 26 recorded J14 specs give events.csv files bit-identical to the pre-A2 build (gate G-A2) and every probe left the random-engine state unchanged; per-event seeding gives bit-identical events for 1, 2 and 4 threads and 1, 2 and 4 jobs, also with a random gun in a test build; the summary written by layered_sim equals core/simulation/summary.py recomputed from the per-event dump (integers identical, floats within 1e-12); a weighted run with observables exits 2; the probe called before BeamOn records nothing (VALIDATION GEANT4-SUMMARY); the layouts are invented, so the status stays demonstrated-on-synthetic-data

adapter 0.3.0 built against Geant4 11.4.3 on E2 (2026-10-24): G4RootAnalysisReader reads MT-merged compressed event files with string columns (gate G-B1a; the MT master cannot fill a merged ntuple, so worker 0 writes the run and processes rows); the J15 geometry passes overlaps, material budget and energy balance; the deterministic field check passes at nominal with one and two field regions (largest in-plane deviation 0.054 um against 0.5 um, TOF times within 1 ps) and catches B x (1 +- 1e-4); layered_sim and element_sim agree on the mean and most probable silicon deposit and the total calorimeter leakage (gate G-B1b); 1, 2 and 4 threads and 1 against 4 jobs give the same event-file content hash (VALIDATION GEANT4-ELEMENT); the layouts are invented, so the status stays demonstrated-on-synthetic-data

adapter 0.4.0 on E2 (2026-10-24): simreco built with Apple clang 21.0.0 (C++17, -ffp-contract=off) passes its unit tests (fitter against the measurement term, determinism, summary against Python, tail sources, estimators; also built and tested in the CI job simreco on Linux); gate G-B2 on a SYNTHETIC J15-like candidate: geometry -> from-geometry -> element_sim -> reco -> table -> label --upgrade -> f4 (both paths, the same evaluation) -> report, a refused upgrade with its reasons, multiple-scattering-reference passing at 1 GV with both density controls caught, tails off within section B.4.2 (VALIDATION GEANT4-F4); the layouts are invented, so the status stays demonstrated-on-synthetic-data

adapter 0.4.1 on E2 (2026-10-24/25): the J15 campaign (examples/design-minimal-spectrometer/live.py, Geant4 11.4.3, element_sim and simreco rebuilt): six tracking studies, charge confusion at 500 GV, shower containment with a four-point cut scan, the verification ladder with every negative control caught, the multiple-scattering reference at 1, 100 and 500 GV; the 1 GV studies qualify through the F4 path (VALIDATION GEANT4-J15); the layouts are invented, so the status stays demonstrated-on-synthetic-data

licence_boundary: Geant4 is distributed under the Geant4 Software License, Version 1.0, 28 June 2006; this plugin is Apache-2.0. Nothing of Geant4 is bundled or copied: geant4_build.py clones the source into the work directory the user names and builds it there, with the user's approval (it contacts github.com and cern.ch); layered_sim and element_sim (and simroot, which reads element_sim's event files with Geant4's own reader) are this plugin's own code, built by the user against that installation and run as separate executables that exchange JSON and CSV files (element_sim also writes ROOT files through Geant4's bundled g4tools; ROOT itself is not needed). No pyproject extra and no required CI job. Gate G5: approved for distribution by the maintainer on 2026-10-21 for layered_sim; element_sim, simroot and the event file of adapter 0.3.0 (written from the Geant4 API, no example code copied or adapted, B1.9) await the reviewer's G5 confirmation in VALIDATION GEANT4-ELEMENT; simreco (adapter 0.4.0) links no Geant4 code at all and reads only the CSV files simroot writes
environment: E2 (docs/capability-matrix.md): macOS 26.5 arm64, Apple clang 21.0.0, CMake 4.3.2, Python 3.13 standard library only on the plugin side; Geant4 11.4.3 built from source by geant4_build.py in ~/Workspace/geant4-work (no system-wide installation), eleven datasets downloaded from cern.ch with MD5 checks. The Apptainer definition assets/geant4.def is declared but not built or tested. Live tests need HEP_GEANT4_LIVE_TEST=1 and HEP_GEANT4_CONFIG
status_rule: the adapter status is the lowest of its tools' statuses; the build and examples stay tested-in-declared-environment only while the recorded build and comparison replay and the live rerun (HEP_GEANT4_LIVE_TEST=1) pass on the declared version; another Geant4 version, compiler or platform is a new test. A completed run, a passed implementation check or agreement with an official example is verification, never physical validity, which hep-detector's study protocol decides (every record stays unvalidated in phase 1)
